rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=24, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-13 CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE (explicitly a confirmation, NOT a new lever -- no ceiling-raiser remains): ONE knob val_n 16->24 on the iter-4 ep6 PEAK cfg (ep6, lr=1e-4, c16, n_iter300, grad_clip1.0, SEED=42 -> 0.9596). This is the prompt's suggested cleaner-read probe: tighten the ~0.96 estimate on a WIDER scored basis. The headline peak 0.9596 and the full 3-seed band (seed42=0.9596, seed123=0.9588 iter-7, seed7=0.9605 iter-12; mean ~0.9596) were all read at val_n=16; iter-9 read val_n=24=0.9609 but on a different draw -- this re-reads the SAME peak seed=42 recon on 24 scans so the headline number itself is on the wider basis (apples-to-apples to the iter-4 peak: only val_n changes). NOT-yet-tried as a confirmation axis = the VAL-SUBSET SAMPLING of the SSIM read at the canonical peak seed; enlarging the scored set 16->24 perturbs ONLY which/how-many per-scan-fit images are averaged, NOT any optimization-strength knob. EXHAUSTED levers AVOIDED: lr anchored 1e-4 (iter-3 0.9553->0.9593); n_iter HURTS via per-scan overfit, no early-stop (iter-2 n_iter600 0.9553->0.9407); pretrain_epochs ep6 PEAK (ep3->6 up 0.9596, ep9 DOWN 0.9593 iter-10, ep12 down 0.9585 iter-5); unet_c flat (iter-6 c16->c32 0.9596->0.9495); grad_clip insensitive in BOTH directions (iter-8 tighter 0.5=0.9597, iter-11 looser 2.0=0.9592); seed noise-stable across 3 draws (0.9588-0.9605); warm_start LOAD-BEARING-POSITIVE, kept True NEVER off; the `optimizer` field is a DEAD knob (warm-start pre-pass + _fit_one_scene HARDCODE Adam, never read cfg['optimizer']; no scheduler hook; activating either needs editing the FORBIDDEN shared solver). Failure mode: per-image U-Net N2I on dense-view 128-angle breast is STRUCTURALLY FBP-BOUNDED -- the half-angle view-split discards information the full-view 128-view LD-FBP keeps, so each per-scan GT-free fit caps BELOW the LD-FBP baseline (hr=0); a substrate ceiling, not an optimization/capacity one. Hypothesis: reading the peak seed=42 recon on 24 val scans lands WITHIN NOISE of the 3-seed band (~0.959-0.961, hr=0), confirming the ~0.96 breast per-image U-Net N2I ceiling is val-subset-stable on a WIDER basis and not a 16-scan sampling artefact -- toward the iter-20 ceiling-documentation mandate. A material drop would mean the 16-scan read was optimistically sampled; a material lift, pessimistically sampled (either way a read-stability note, still no climbable lever). Wall: iter-9 (val_n24, gc1.0, seed42) ran ~700s; identical cfg here -> est ~700-720s, well under the 900s/15-min wall (outer_wall_s=1500 hard cap).
